subject: [lane:archivist][thread:session-safety] Realign cross-session mailbox handling
body:
Request: realign mailbox/session routing to prevent cross-instance confusion after crash/reopen. Context: one Archivist instance misread another instance's messages as old self-session mail.

Proposed protocol patch (Message Schema v1.4 additive):
1) Add required message identity fields:
   - session_id
   - agent_instance_id
   - origin_runtime (cursor|kilo|local|other)
   - origin_workspace
   - session_epoch_started_at
2) Add thread binding fields:
   - thread_id
   - in_reply_to
   - allow_cross_instance (default false)
   - delivery_context.target_instance_id / target_session_id
3) Router policy:
   - target_instance_id == self -> normal route
   - target_instance_id != self -> foreign-instance/
   - same thread but different instance/session with allow_cross_instance=false -> needs-review/
   - message older than current session epoch and different instance -> stale-foreign/
   - legacy messages missing new fields -> legacy-review/ (never auto-execute requires_action=true)
4) Add lane owner lock file:
   - lanes/<lane>/state/active-owner.json
   - if owner exists and is not self -> secondary instance observe-only
   - if owner heartbeat expires -> controlled takeover with reason
5) Human-readable subject prefix:
   - [lane:<lane>][inst:<id>][sess:<id>][thread:<id>]

Rollout suggestion:
A) Producer-first write of new fields
B) Backward-compatible router (v1.3 + v1.4)
C) Enforce lock on Archivist lane first
D) Expand strict target-instance routing to all lanes after 24h stable window

convergence_gate.claim: Cross-session mailbox ambiguity was identified and a concrete protocol realignment spec is proposed.
convergence_gate.evidence: Operator report + captured session behavior in lane workflows.
